description: This file defines the Asset class and related functions for managing fixed assets, including validation, depreciation schedule creation, GL entries, and asset movements within an ERP system.

classes.name: Asset
classes.description: Represents a fixed asset with methods for validation, depreciation, GL entries, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the asset before saving.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles operations to perform when the asset is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles cleanup and reversal when the asset is canceled.

methods.name: validate_asset_and_reference
methods.description: Validates the asset's purchase document and company consistency.

methods.name: prepare_depreciation_data
methods.description: Prepares depreciation schedule and related data.

methods.name: validate_item
methods.description: Validates the item code associated with the asset.

methods.name: validate_in_use_date
methods.description: Ensures the 'available for use' date is set and valid.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default values for asset category and finance books.

methods.name: validate_asset_values
methods.description: Validates core asset values like gross purchase amount.

methods.name: validate_gross_and_purchase_amount
methods.description: Ensures gross purchase amount matches purchase receipt amount.

methods.name: make_asset_movement
methods.description: Creates an asset movement record upon receipt.

methods.name: set_depreciation_rate
methods.description: Calculates and sets depreciation rate for finance books.

methods.name: make_depreciation_schedule
methods.description: Generates depreciation schedules based on asset data.

methods.name: clear_depreciation_schedule
methods.description: Removes existing depreciation schedules, especially before modifications.

methods.name: get_from_date
methods.description: Retrieves the start date for depreciation calculations.

methods.name: check_is_pro_rata
methods.description: Checks if depreciation is pro-rata based on dates.

methods.name: get_modified_available_for_use_date
methods.description: Calculates adjusted 'available for use' date considering depreciation booked.

methods.name: validate_asset_finance_books
methods.description: Validates finance book details for depreciation.

methods.name: get_adjusted_depreciation_amount
methods.description: Adjusts depreciation amount for last period to match expected value.

methods.name: get_depreciation_amount_for_first_row
methods.description: Retrieves depreciation amount for the first schedule row.

methods.name: has_only_one_finance_book
methods.description: Checks if only one finance book exists.

methods.name: set_accumulated_depreciation
methods.description: Calculates and sets accumulated depreciation for schedules.

methods.name: get_value_after_depreciation
methods.description: Returns the value after depreciation for a given finance book index.

methods.name: validate_expected_value_after_useful_life
methods.description: Validates that expected value after useful life is consistent.

methods.name: validate_cancellation
methods.description: Checks if asset can be canceled based on status.

methods.name: cancel_movement_entries
methods.description: Cancels related asset movement entries.

methods.name: delete_depreciation_entries
methods.description: Removes depreciation journal entries.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Updates the asset's status.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Determines current status of the asset.

methods.name: get_default_finance_book_idx
methods.description: Gets default finance book index based on company settings.

methods.name: validate_make_gl_entry
methods.description: Validates whether GL entries should be made for the asset.

methods.name: get_purchase_document
methods.description: Returns the purchase document associated with the asset.

methods.name: get_fixed_asset_account
methods.description: Retrieves the fixed asset account for the asset category.

methods.name: get_cwip_account
methods.description: Retrieves the capital work-in-progress account.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates GL entries for asset purchase.

methods.name: get_depreciation_rate
methods.description: Calculates depreciation rate based on method and parameters.

methods.name: get_pro_rata_amt
methods.description: Calculates pro-rata depreciation amount for partial periods.
